author: kwame
text:
Sprint 22 kicks off today. Goal: everything a design-partner beta needs. Board: ATLAS-30 epic. Highlights:
• ATLAS-37 API v1 (Alex)
• ATLAS-36 rollout controls UI (Sam)
• ATLAS-38 security review (Jordan)
• ATLAS-40 load test (Ben)
• ATLAS-41 SSO verification (Ingrid) — GA scope, not beta
Please keep tickets current; Priya reads the board, not my summaries.

author: alex
text: API v1 is mostly endpoints + tests now. Pagination (PR #207) should land tomorrow.

author: sam
text: Rollout controls: kill switch flag `atlas.enabled` is PR #212, the percentage slider UI is the bigger piece (ATLAS-36). Design from Chloe expected Wednesday.

author: wei
text: Q for whoever knows the metering consumer: Tomás's handoff doc says 'bucket by UTC — TODO before DST'. Does anyone know if that TODO was done? Tomás is out until Jan.

author: lucas
text: Not done as far as I know. The consumer still keys hourly buckets on workspace local time. I own the topic schema, not the consumer.

author: wei
text: Ok. DST ends Sunday Nov 1. I'll make a ticket but it's not in this sprint.

author: kwame
text: Make the ticket and tag it `data-correctness`. Let's look at it Wednesday.

author: alex
text: PR #207 pagination merged. Cursor-based, 500 max page size. Docs ticket for Isabel.

author: isabel
text: Got it, adding to the API guide draft.

author: ben
text: Load test plan for ATLAS-40 is up: 200 concurrent users, mix of 7/30/90-day dashboard queries, 30 minutes, against staging. Running Friday morning.

author: alex
text: 90-day queries are the scary ones. Rollups help but we don't cache yet.

author: wei
text: PR #209 rollup tables merged. Hourly + daily rollups per workspace. Backfill finished on staging.

author: sam
text: PR #212 merged: `atlas.enabled` (kill switch) and `atlas.rollout_pct` flags live in LaunchDarkly for staging + prod, default off.

author: devon
text: Nice. I'll add a runbook step for flipping the kill switch during an incident. ATLAS-49 to verify it end to end on staging.

author: alex
text: Opened PR #214 — Atlas API v1. It's big (~3.4k lines), sorry. Endpoints: workspaces, usage, dashboards, exports. 162 tests so far. Reviews from Wei + Grace-when-she-starts welcome.

author: ben
text:
ATLAS-40 load test results:
• 7-day: p95 140 ms, p99 260 ms
• 30-day: p95 210 ms, p99 420 ms
• 90-day: p95 610 ms, p99 1.4 s :warning:
• Error rate 0.02%
Full report in the ticket. 90-day is over our 800 ms p99 target.

author: alex
text: Expected. Opened ATLAS-47 for a query cache on 90-day ranges. Won't land before beta.

author: priya
text: Decision: beta limits date ranges to 30 days. 90-day ships with GA once ATLAS-47 lands. Chloe/Nadia, please make the picker reflect that.

author: nadia
text: On it, I'll cap the picker behind the flag.

author: nadia
text: PR #211 CSV export UI merged. Exports use the workspace's timezone for timestamps.

author: grace
text: Dumb question: is the source of truth for usage numbers the `usage_events` table or the rollups? The API seems to read rollups but the incident channel talks about raw events.

author: alex
text: Not dumb! Raw events in `usage_events` are the source of truth. Rollups are derived hourly/daily for speed and the API reads them. If they ever disagree, raw events win and we re-run the rollup.

author: sofia
text: +1. And the warehouse (Snowflake) copies raw events nightly, so analytics numbers lag by up to a day.

author: devon
text: :warning: Staging deploys are stuck: a migration from PR #214's branch took an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on `usage_rollups` and the deploy job timed out. Rolling back. INC-2294 (Sev3, staging only).

author: alex
text: My bad, that migration adds an index without CONCURRENTLY. Will fix in the PR.

author: devon
text: Staging back up after 41 minutes. I'm adding a CI check that rejects non-concurrent index creation on big tables (PR #222).

author: grace
text: My first PR is merged :tada: #225 adds request ids to API error responses.

author: devon
text: PR #222 merged. Migrations that lock tables over 1M rows now fail CI.

author: devon
text: ATLAS-49 done: flipped `atlas.enabled` off on staging during a synthetic load run. Atlas UI and API returned 404 within 9 seconds across all pods. Kill switch works. Runbook updated.

author: alex
text: PR #214 Atlas API v1 merged :tada: 184/184 tests passing, including the 14 cross-tenant tests from #216.

author: kwame
text: Huge. Thanks Alex and reviewers.

author: alex
text: Staging deploy done. p95 API latency 180 ms on the standard dashboard mix. 30-day queries p99 390 ms. 90-day p99 still ~1.1 s with Grace's partial cache, but that's capped off for beta.

author: sam
text: Fixing the last accessibility check on PR #219: keyboard focus order on the rollout slider (focus jumps to the kill switch). The rollout control is not merged yet; I expect to merge around 3 PM PT-ish... sorry, 3 PM ET, once Leo re-reviews.

author: leo
text: I can re-review at 2:45 ET, I have a design system sync until then.
